apps.name: SuperStore
apps.subtitle: An alternative app store for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: SuperStore installs and refreshes sideloaded apps with your own Apple ID, entirely on the phone. This entry is how an installed copy learns about new published builds: when a newer version appears here, My Apps offers an Update that downloads it and installs it over the copy on the phone.

entitlements.aps-environment: Push notifications remind you before sideloaded apps expire.
entitlements.com.apple.developer.siri: Siri shortcuts refresh all your apps.
entitlements.com.apple.security.application-groups: Shares its database with the Home Screen widget.

privacy.NSLocalNetwork: Finds a Bonjour service on your local network. Not needed for core features.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUse: Keeps background refreshes running while the app is open.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUse: Keeps background refreshes running while the app is in the background.
